# `aitbc node island health`

Show health status of connected islands.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc node island health [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--node-url` | text | `http://127.0.0.1:8202` | no | Local node RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |
| `--all` | flag | `false` | no | Show all islands including default |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc node island health
```
